tools.name: tariffmonkee-content
tools.description: Converts a URL to clean Markdown using a real rendered browser (JavaScript executed). Results are cached for 24 hours per URL, so repeat requests for the same page are fast and do not re-render. Costs $0.002 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-extract
tools.description: Extracts structured JSON from text already in hand, matching a JSON Schema supplied by the caller, using AI. No browser render, so it costs less than /extract-url. Takes content and schema; returns data and the model used. Costs $0.016 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-extract-url
tools.description: Fetches a URL in a rendered browser and extracts structured JSON matching a caller-supplied JSON Schema in one call, using AI with multi-model fallback. Cached for 24 hours per URL and schema. For text already in hand, /extract costs less. Costs $0.021 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-aeo-audit
tools.description: AI-readiness audit for a URL: checks schema.org structured data, crawlability (robots.txt, meta robots, canonical) and llms.txt presence, then returns a 0-100 score with specific recommendations. Cached for 24 hours per URL. Costs $0.031 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-search
tools.description: Web search results as clean JSON: up to 10 ranked results per query with title, URL and snippet. Three search providers with automatic failover. Optional region=tw selects a Traditional Chinese, Taiwan-region search lane. Cached for 24 hours per query and region. Costs $0.005 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-screenshot
tools.description: Returns a full-page PNG screenshot of a URL, captured in a real rendered browser (JavaScript executed). The response body is the image, not JSON. Cached for 24 hours per URL; X-Cached and X-Fetched-At response headers report cache status and fetch time. Costs $0.01 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-pdf
tools.description: Returns a PDF of a full web page, rendered in a real browser (JavaScript executed). The response body is the file, not JSON. Cached for 24 hours per URL; X-Cached and X-Fetched-At response headers report cache status and fetch time. Costs $0.01 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-linkcheck
tools.description: URL safety verdict: follows the redirect chain, detects homograph and punycode hostname tricks, and cross-references the destination host against the URLhaus threat feed. Returns safe, suspicious or malicious with reasons. Single-URL scope; domain-wide grading is /sitegrade and registration facts ar

tools.name: tariffmonkee-sitegrade
tools.description: Domain security grade (0-100, A-F) from HTTPS reachability, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) and CAA records. Reports HTTPS connect success or failure, not raw certificate expiry. Registration facts are in /domain-intel; URL r

tools.name: tariffmonkee-domain-intel
tools.description: Domain ownership and registration intelligence via RDAP: registration age, registrar, privacy-proxy status, expiration date, nameservers and detected mail provider. Technical configuration grading is in /sitegrade; URL reputation is in /linkcheck. Costs $0.021 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-email-verify
tools.description: Email deliverability verdict: checks syntax, MX record presence, disposable-domain match and SPF/DMARC presence. Returns deliverable, risky or undeliverable with reasons. Scoped to one address, not a domain security audit. Costs $0.002 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-trust-audit
tools.description: One confidence-weighted trust verdict for a domain, URL or email: runs linkcheck, sitegrade and domain-intel (plus email-verify when an email is supplied) and flags disagreement between sources, such as a very new domain with a mature TLS setup, instead of concatenating outputs. At least one of doma

tools.name: tariffmonkee-gbp-audit
tools.description: Google Business Profile audit for a local business: visibility score, missing fields, review health, AI-readiness flags and a fix list. Uses DataForSEO Business Data for category, contact info, hours, claimed status, photos and review rating distribution. Costs $0.05 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-serp-check
tools.description: Google organic ranking check: finds whether and where a domain ranks for a keyword, using DataForSEO SERP data. Returns found, position, URL, title and total organic results. Costs $0.021 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-ai-visibility
tools.description: AI answer visibility check: sends a real query to a live AI model with web search enabled and checks the response for a mention of the business and a citation linking to its domain. Returns mentioned, cited, citations and an excerpt. Costs $0.031 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-visibility-report
tools.description: White-label local visibility report for one business, returned as an application/pdf file (not JSON): Google Business Profile completeness, organic ranking for a target keyword and AI answer-engine visibility for a buyer-intent query. No TariffMonkee branding appears in the output, so agencies can p

tools.name: tariffmonkee-lead-list
tools.description: Audit-qualified lead list as CSV: takes up to 10 local businesses, checks each Google Business Profile (claimed status, photos, hours, website, description, rating, review count) and returns only those with at least one red flag. Cheaper per business than /gbp-audit when the full batch is used. Cost

tools.name: tariffmonkee-lead-discovery
tools.description: Local lead discovery as CSV: finds businesses for a category and area from Google Maps data, checks each profile, and returns up to 10 with at least one red flag (unclaimed, missing photos, hours or website, low rating, few reviews). No starting list required. Costs $0.75 per call via x402.

tools.name: tariffmonkee-research
tools.description: Research bundle: takes a query and returns up to 10 deduplicated, rendered web sources as one token-budgeted Markdown bundle (about 8,000 tokens), one source per domain. Combines web search with rendered-page fetching in a single call. Needs at least 3 fetched sources; the response reports sources_r

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tariffmonkee-search, tariffmonkee-screenshot, tariffmonkee-pdf, tariffmonkee-gbp-audit, tariffmonkee-serp-check, tariffmonkee-lead-list, tariffmonkee-lead-discovery · Private data: tariffmonkee-pdf, tariffmonkee-sitegrade, tariffmonkee-email-verify, tariffmonkee-gbp-audit, tariffmonkee-visibility-report, tariffmonkee-research · Public sink: tariffmonkee-email-verify, tariffmonkee-trust-audit · Destructive: tariffmonkee-research.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tariffmonkee-search, tariffmonkee-screenshot, tariffmonkee-pdf, tariffmonkee-gbp-audit, tariffmonkee-serp-check, tariffmonkee-lead-list, tariffmonkee-lead-discovery · Private data: tariffmonkee-pdf, tariffmonkee-sitegrade, tariffmonkee-email-verify, tariffmonkee-gbp-audit, tariffmonkee-visibility-report, tariffmonkee-research · Public sink: tariffmonkee-email-verify, tariffmonkee-trust-audit · Destructive: tariffmonkee-research

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
